measurements.hypothesis: A fixture that registers a timer, a listener, and an auxiliary effect through ctx.effect returns to its effect baseline after N loader restarts and its timer disposer runs N times; a raw setInterval without ctx.effect leaks one handle per restart.

measurements.title: 等待 / waiting for an injected service instead of failing
measurements.hypothesis: A consumer that declares inject=[service] stays PENDING without a TypeError while the provider is absent; inserting the provider entry and awaiting the loader once makes the consumer ACTIVE. Direct ctx.service access without inject throws instead.

measurements.title: 事件 / waterfall next-vs-veto and listener failure modes
measurements.hypothesis: A waterfall listener that calls next() preserves the next listener and the inner callback; one that returns a veto value short-circuits both. A throwing notification listener is contained only in parallel mode (all listeners run, AggregateError); emit/serial/bail stop at the throwing listener, which is the documented dispatch behavior.

measurements.hypothesis: Two named loader isolate labels give two consumers separate lev5Svc instances; restarting provider A changes consumer A to the new implementation with no consumer edit while consumer B keeps b1; a root-scope consumer stays PENDING (no cross-realm bleed).

Isolate is configuration-sensitive: a missing or mismatched label makes a consumer PENDING rather than falling back to the root scope (this is what the negative control observes).
